title: Offline Mode
changes: Adds opt-in Essential, Standard and Full offline learning packs in Settings.
Shows live download progress, stored file count, offline-pack size and available browser storage.
Essential stores the core app, Japan Ready, current topic and currently used local media.
Standard adds introduced-word media plus locally referenced Theatre, Manga, conversation and grammar content.
Full adds all locally referenced vocabulary and learning media currently known to Kaishi Quest.
Adds an Offline ready / Offline status indicator beside the version badge.
Offline content is stored separately and can be removed without deleting learning progress or normal app caches.
Service worker now falls back to downloaded offline content for documents, scripts, styles, images, audio and JSON/data.
